versions.description:
# Name Color and Gradient

Lets players style their in-game name with a solid hex color or a two-color gradient.

Commands:

- `/setcolor <hex>` applies one solid color, for example `/setcolor C827F5`.
- `/setgradient <hex1> <hex2>` applies a gradient, for example `/setgradient C827F5 27F5EE`.

Choices are saved per player and reapplied when the player reconnects.

## Compatibility note

This module sends the `ocn` console command and uses 7 Days to Die color tags. It only works on servers where that command/mod support is available. If the game server rejects `ocn`, the connector misses the reconnect event, or the server strips rich text in a specific context, the color may not apply every time and the player may need to run the command again.

## Screenshots

![Colored player name in chat](/images/millie/name-color-system-chat.webp)

![Gradient applied confirmation](/images/millie/name-color-system-gradient-applied.webp)

![Set gradient command example](/images/millie/name-color-system-setgradient-command.webp)

commands.name: setColor
commands.description: Set your in-game name to a solid hex color.
commands.helpText: Usage: /setcolor <hex>. Example: /setcolor C827F5. Requires a 7D2D server/mod that supports the ocn console command.

arguments.name: color
arguments.helpText: Six-digit hex color, with or without #. Example: C827F5

commands.name: setGradient
commands.description: Set your in-game name to a two-color gradient.
commands.helpText: Usage: /setgradient <hex1> <hex2>. Example: /setgradient C827F5 27F5EE. Requires a 7D2D server/mod that supports the ocn console command.

arguments.name: color1
arguments.helpText: Starting six-digit hex color, with or without #.

arguments.name: color2
arguments.helpText: Ending six-digit hex color, with or without #.

hooks.name: loadSavedNameColor
hooks.description: Reapplies a saved solid color or gradient when the player connects.
